description: What a style gives a project: a link that makes the whole Echo site wear its colours, the commands that put it in a project, and, for a project without a terminal, its theme CSS and a DESIGN.md with its rules. One of Echo's styles by name, or the builder's own style.json. A style the slop police stops isn't worn; the answer says what to ask the builder.

files.description: Include the theme CSS and DESIGN.md (the default). False when the builder will run the command in a project, which writes both itself.

style.description: The builder's own style.json, as a JSON object.

name: wear_style
title: Wear a style
